name: CertiFoolProof
description: CertiFoolProof is a certificate verification system that ensures authenticity with zero tolerance for fakes, supporting both faculty and clubs effortlessly.

paragraphs: Issue certificates that can be verified in seconds and cannot be faked.

CertiFoolProof is a certificate issuing and verification platform for institutions, faculty and student clubs. Every issued certificate receives a unique ID, a SHA-256 integrity hash and a QR code that resolves to a public verification page. A separate, account-free bulk generator produces certificates for hundreds of participants entirely in the browser.
features: Available at /generate/bulk. Nothing is uploaded: participant lists, artwork and signatures never leave the browser.

Participants: CSV upload (delimiter auto-detected: , ; Tab |, UTF-8 BOM handled) or paste one name per line. The name column is detected automatically. Up to 5,000 certificates per batch. A sample CSV can be downloaded.
Design: three built-in presets (Classic, Neo, Minimal), or your own background artwork (PNG/JPEG/WebP, up to 10 MB). Page sizes: A4 landscape/portrait, US Letter landscape, 16:9 widescreen or square.

Element-level editor: every text line (participant name, organization, heading, line above name, body, date, date label, signatory name, signatory title) is an independent element. Click it on the preview to drag,…

Layout tools (above the live preview, on both the bulk and issuing pages): drag the side handles of a wrapping text box to set its width; the body stops after 3 lines by default, which can be raised up to 12 or lifted…
